entities.summary: Emily Ann Engstler is an American professional basketball player for the Portland Fire of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA). She previously played for the Indiana Fever, Minnesota Lynx and Washington Mystics. She played college basketball for Syracuse during her first three years at the college level, then for Louisville, earning first-team All-ACC honors in her only season with the team. Engstler graduated from St. Francis Preparatory School in Queens, New York, where she was rated a five-star recruit by ESPN and named a McDonald's All-American.
